# Kanban — Technical Reference Complete reference for `@filemark/kanban` + its integration into `@filemark/mdx`. Purely visual — groups a CSV by a column and renders each group as a column of cards. **No drag-drop**, no shadow state. Source of truth is always the CSV on disk; filemark re-renders on auto-refresh. - Package: `@filemark/kanban` (`packages/kanban/`) - Plan: `docsi/KANBAN_PLAN.md` - Integration: `@filemark/mdx` — `MDXViewer.components.code` ("kanban" lang) + `components.kanban` tag handler. - Showcase: `examples/kanban-full.md` --- ## 1. Goals - **Board view from a CSV with one flag** (`group-by=`). - **Zero new deps** — reuses `parseCSV` + `CellRenderer` from `@filemark/datagrid`; every rich column type (status, avatar, tags, currency, progress, rating, …) just works inside cards. - **Read-only on purpose.** Filemark is a markdown viewer; users edit the CSV in their editor. No drag-drop complexity, no shadow state, no write-back infrastructure. - **Same grammar as datagrid + chart.** Info-string on a fence or HTML attrs on a tag; `src=` resolves via `AssetResolver` or direct fetch; `` tag mirrors ``. - **Pluggable card layouts.** A `registerCardRenderer()` registry lets hosts ship alternate layouts without touching core. --- ## 2. Authoring Fenced block: ````md ```kanban group-by=status order=todo,wip,done card-title=title card-fields=owner,priority id,title,status,owner,priority r-1,Ship grid v2,wip,Ada,P0 r-2,Typed filters,done,Grace,P1 ``` ```` Tag: ```md ``` --- ## 3. Info-string / attribute grammar | Flag | Default | Notes | |---|---|---| | `group-by=` | first column | Cards are grouped by its distinct values. | | `order=` | first-appearance | Explicit column order. Values not present in the data are skipped. | | `card-title=` | first non-groupBy non-id column | Primary line of each card. | | `card-fields=` | remaining columns | Secondary fields; rendered via datagrid's `CellRenderer`. | | `card-badge=` | — | Corner badge on each card (e.g. priority pill). | | `card-layout=` | `default` | Registered layout id. | | `id-column=` / `type:=id` | — | Stable row id for React keys. | | `type:=` | inferred | Force a column type (status / avatar / tags / …). Same grammar as datagrid. | | `align:=` | inferred | Per-column alignment. | | `hide=` | — | Exclude from card rendering. | | `sort=[:asc\|desc]` | file order | Within-column card order. | | `count` / `no-count` | on | Column header shows card count. | | `empty` / `no-empty` | on | Show or hide groups with zero cards. | | `title=` | — | Board title above the columns. | | `height=` | 420 | Scrollable board area height. | | `src=` | — | Relative path via `AssetResolver`; absolute URL fetched directly. | | `delimiter=` | `,` | CSV parse override. | | `header` / `no-header` | on | First row is header. | Unknown flag → `console.warn`; board still renders. --- ## 4. Pipeline ``` ```kanban group-by=… ──▶ remarkCodeMeta copies meta → hast data-meta ──▶ MDXViewer.components.code sees lang === "kanban" ──▶ ──▶ parseKanbanInfoString(meta) → KanbanOptions ──▶ KanbanFromText parses CSV via datagrid parseCSV → { columns, rows } ──▶ Kanban validates + groupRows(rows, columns, options) → KanbanGroup[] ──▶ → * N → * cards ``` Card fields route to `@filemark/datagrid`'s `CellRenderer`, which means status pills / avatars / tags / currency / rating / progress / date / relative / etc. render identically to how they do in the datagrid. --- ## 5. Plug-in contracts ### Card layout registry ```ts interface CardRenderer { readonly id: string; render(ctx: { row: Row; columns: Column[]; options: KanbanOptions; rowId: string }): ReactElement; } ``` ```ts registerCardRenderer({ id: "compact", render: ({ row, options, columns }) => (
{ /* single-line layout */ }
), }); ``` Built-in layouts: - `default` — vertical stack: primary title, optional badge, fields below rendered via the datagrid's CellRenderer. - (future) `compact` — single-line dense card for many-card boards. --- ## 6. Integration with `@filemark/mdx` - `components.code` — new branch: `if (lang === "kanban") return `. - `components.kanban` — `` HTML-tag dispatch, parallel to `` / ``. - Missing-src fallback: amber warning card ("For inline data use a ```kanban fenced block."). Rule 3 — skeleton honesty. --- ## 7. Non-goals (explicit) - **Drag-drop cards between columns.** Filemark is a reader. If a card's status changes in the user's reality, they update the CSV and auto-refresh re-renders. This keeps the component stateless and aligned with filemark's "markdown is source of truth" philosophy. - **Write-back to the CSV file.** Would require FSA write permission + a separate conflict-resolution story. Out of scope. - **Real-time collaboration / multi-user state.** Single-user local-only. --- ## 8. Backlog (ranked) ### Tier A — small / useful - **`src=#id` fence reference** — `` pointing at a prior ` ```csv id=tasks ` fence. Shares data with the datagrid / chart on the same page. Needs a small remark pass. - **`md` task-list ingest** — `` reads the current document's `- [ ] [todo] …` task lines as a kanban source, no CSV required. - **Compact card layout** registered as `card-layout=compact` — one-line horizontal card for dense boards. - **Column width flag** — `column-width=280`, defaulting to 240. ### Tier B — structural - **Swimlanes** — `swimlane=` adds a second dimension (columns × lanes). Common for team-view roadmaps. - **WIP limits** — `limit:wip=3` warns (color bar on the column header) when count exceeds limit. - **Collapsed columns** — click column header to collapse; persisted via `StorageAdapter`. - **Column background tinting** — `column-color:todo=muted, column-color:done=success` tints the column background per group. ### Tier C — nice-to-have - **SVG / PNG export** of the whole board (like chart). - **Filter search box** — top-of-board text filter over card content (like datagrid's global search). - **Card click → detail drawer** showing the full row expanded (parallels datagrid's row-expansion detail panel). - **Keyboard nav** — arrows between cards, tab between columns. --- ## 9. Related docs - `docsi/KANBAN_PLAN.md` — the plan this doc implements. - `docsi/DATAGRID.md` — reference pattern; kanban reuses the datagrid's parseCSV + CellRenderer. - `docsi/CHART.md` — paired plug-in model; registrable renderer pattern is identical. - `docsi/ARCHITECTURE.md` §11 — where the new lang-branch + tag handler slot into `MDXViewer`. - `docsi/ROADMAP.md` pillar 3 (Tasks & organization) — kanban is the third shipped component.
